reason: Adds a new lazy duplicate-key-check option and threads it through core write paths (`insert`, `update`, `replace`, `load data`, write/common table code) plus planner and session variable handling. Duplicate-key enforcement is a correctness-critical table/index semantics change with potential data-integrity, conflict-detection, and execution-behavior regressions across broad DML paths, so it is central and risky enough for a focused deep review.
